procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
summary: Request for relocation of aggressive stray cattle to gaushalas, or vaccination/sterilization of community dogs under ABC rules.
estimated_total_time: 24 hours for cattle; 3–5 days for ABC dog sterilization

steps.title: Register complaint on citizen app
steps.description: Select 'Stray Animal Issue', upload photograph of animal group, and provide exact street landmark.

steps.title: Cattle catching squad dispatch
steps.description: Specialized vehicle equipped with hydraulic ramp impounds stray cattle and transports them to municipal gaushala.

steps.title: Animal Birth Control (ABC) process for dogs
steps.description: Registered animal welfare NGO captures dogs humanely, performs spaying/neutering, rabies vaccination, ear notching, and releases them back into original territory.

steps.title: Confirmation SMS
steps.description: Complainant receives resolution alert with photograph of cleared area.
